mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits monoamine oxidase (MAO) and CYP3A4/CYP2D6, potentially increasing lisdexamfetamine metabolite levels and sympathomimetic effects, while lisdexamfetamine may increase CNS stimulation and peripheral sympathetic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and psychiatric symptoms closely; consider alternative TB therapy if possible; educate patient on avoiding excessive stimulants and report palpitations or severe headache immediately.
